description_en: Queries the list of user zero trust policies
description_zh: 列表查询用户零信任策略
name: ListUserPrivateAccessPolicies

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page set for the paginated query. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the private access policy. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length, and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问策略名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

Polices.description_en: The list of authorized access policies
Polices.description_zh: 被授权访问的策略列表

CustomUserAttributes.description_en: The collection of custom user group attributes. Multiple custom user group attributes have an OR relationship and take effect as a union
CustomUserAttributes.description_zh: 自定义用户组属性集合。多个自定义用户组属性之间是或的关系，按照合集生效

IdpId.description_en: The identity provider ID of the user group. This value exists when the custom user group type is department
IdpId.description_zh: 用户组的身份源ID。当自定义用户组类型为department时，存在该值

Relation.description_en:
The relationship of the user group. Valid values:
Equal: equal to.
Unequal: not equal to
Relation.description_zh:
用户组的关系。取值：
Equal：等于。
Unequal：不等于

UserGroupType.description_en:
The type of the user group. Valid values:
username: the username.
department: the department.
email: the email address.
telephone: the mobile phone number
UserGroupType.description_zh:
用户组的类型。取值：
username：用户名。
department：部门。
email：邮箱。
telephone：手机

Value.description_en:
The value of the user group attribute.
When the user group type is username, this parameter indicates the value of the username. The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length, and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
When the user group type is department, this parameter indicates the value of the department. For example: OU=Department1,OU=SASE DingTalk.
When the user group type is email, this parameter indicates the value of the email address. For example: username@example.com.
When the user group type is telephone, this parameter indicates the value of the mobile phone number. For example: 13900001234
Value.description_zh:
用户组属性的值。
当用户组类型为username时，表示用户名的值。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
当用户组类型为department时，表示部门的值。如：OU=部门1,OU=SASE钉钉。
当用户组类型为email时，表示邮箱的值。如：username@example.com。
当用户组类型为telephone时，表示手机的值。如：13900001234

MatchedUserGroup.description_en: The user group to which the policy belongs

Name.description_en: The name of the private access policy

PolicyAction.description_en:
The action of the private access policy. Valid values:
Block: blocks the access.
Allow: allows the access
PolicyAction.description_zh:
内网访问策略动作。取值：
Block：阻断。
Allow：允许

PolicyId.description_en: The ID of the private access policy

Priority.description_en: The priority of the private access policy. The number 1 indicates the highest priority
Priority.description_zh: 内网访问策略优先级。数字1表示优先级最高

TrustedProcessGroupIds.description_en: The list of trusted process group IDs

TrustedSoftwareIds.description_en: The list of trusted software IDs

UserGroupMode.description_en:
The user group type of the private access policy. Valid values:
Normal: a normal user group.
Custom: a custom user group
UserGroupMode.description_zh:
内网访问策略的用户组类型。取值：
Normal：普通用户组。
Custom：自定义用户组

TotalNum.description_en: The total number of authorized access policies
TotalNum.description_zh: 被授权访问的策略总数
